latest_release.name: v3.99.9
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update module github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 to v4.1.6 [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5490
* Update module golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5492
* Add Interrupt and UserActionable errors by @mcastorina in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5491
* Clean up Postman source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5510
* Clean up GCS source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5509
* Use shared logtest helpers in source debug logging tests by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5519
* Fix Git diff scans at shallow clone boundaries by @bIackr0se in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5360
* Update github-actions by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5478
* Update module go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver to v1.17.10 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5505
* Update module github.com/ulikunitz/xz to v0.5.17 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5504
* Update github.com/trufflesecurity/ldap-verify digest to 0f42b08 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5503
* Update module github.com/gabriel-vasile/mimetype to v1.4.16 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5479
* Clean up Jenkins source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5520
* Time detector_execution_duration per detector run by @unsmith in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5526
* fix(sqlserver): use driver's default port in pre-dial check by @jordanTunstill in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5527
* Update github-actions by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5533
* Clean up CircleCI and Travis CI logging, share API log hooks by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5524
* Clean up Hugging Face source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5523
* Clean up Elasticsearch source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5521
* feat(detectors): add Serval API key detector by @serval-frenchie in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5528
* Update module golang.org/x/crypto to v0.59.0 [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5544
* Update module pault.ag/go/debian to v0.21.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5546
* Clean up Syslog source logging for per-source debug by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5538
* Fix GitHub GraphQL comment scan retries and paging by @kashifkhan0771 in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5548
* Report Datadog resources as unbounded instead of permission-less bindings by @unsmith in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5539
* Add SOURCE_TYPE_GENERIC source type by @martinlocklear in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5553

## New Contributors
* @bIackr0se made their first contribution in https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/pull/5360

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/compare/v3.99.8...v3.99.9
